limits: Triage only. The model ranks findings by how much they look like past candidates that survived triage. It does not verify anything.
Zero verified-real positives exist in the training data, so the model never predicts VERIFIED_REAL and must never be used to claim one. A high score means 'worth a live probe', nothing more.

Label skew: the training set is 86% worth-validating / 14% likely-false-positive (2333 positive / 378 negative of 2711 rows). Accuracy near the majority baseline means the model learned nothing; judge it by minority-class recall and ROC AUC instead.
Findings from plugins or chains unseen in training fall into the OTHER bucket; the model has no opinion about them beyond the generic features.

Multichain coverage is uneven by design: several chains (Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Dash, Toncoin, Sui, Aptos, XRP, Avalanche) have no real labeled rows in the public corpora fetched for v3 and were EXCLUDED, not faked. Their chain one-hots exist but carry no learned signal.

NVD CVE rows are all label 1 (a published CVE is a confirmed vulnerability); there is no honest negative set for web / hardware / node CVEs, so those domains skew positive and the model may over-score them. Judge web/hardware scores with that in mind.
